title: AATIP as part of a government disclosure effort

tellings.quote: mean as recent as like 2015 16 I mean ATIP was certainly part of that effort.

plain: As recently as 2015 and 2016, AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, was part of a government effort to slowly reveal what it knows about UFOs, according to Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a recovered UFO. Barber passes this on from what he was told. If true, it would mean the office was part of a planned move to tell the public.
